title: Skinned rig: whole-body motion + spring secondary, ROUND 2 (pixel-aware amplitude, elegant posing)
question: Does authored whole-body motion (pelvis bob/sway/rotation, counter-rotating chest, overlapping arms, IK-planted feet with heel-to-toe roll, lagging head, squash and stretch) with spring-simulated hair, bun, bow, sleeves and skirt fix the owner's verdict on the H2 animations ('stiff and unnatural, joints off, need more dynamic movement and bouncing parts')?
method: Motion files in the CONTRACT format (motion/<act>.json, 24 fps source, sprite frames with timing_ms) baked by motion/scripts/mbuild.py: analytic 2-bone leg IK on a treadmill foot track (no slide at travel_m_per_s); compass-gait pelvis height for the walk (DOWN lowest, UP highest); phase-lag overlap from shoulder to hand; head lag spring; damped particle chains for every secondary chain (gravity hang, travel drag, cone limits, head/thigh/torso collision, skirt panels driven by the thighs, settled loops with seam <= 0.4 mm). Rendered with R's render_motion.py (--preview for the boards; full pixel chain + head stamp for the GIFs). 7 critique rounds (Opus + Argon) on numbered SE/E frame grids + onion skins, then A/B against the old rejected frames. pxeval seq on the SE pixel frames.
result: ROUND 2 (on R's r5 rig with the master-textured animatable head, P's chain, no stamp): every motion ≥1 px at 1x or held (walk pelvis bob 3.1 px, head roll/nod ±7/±3°, bangs 2.3, side locks 5.8, back hair 7, bun 2.7, bow 4.3, skirt 4.7 px p-p); snappier holds (walk 90/120/90/120 ms, run 60/80/60/80); upright posture, chest lifted, soft close arms, idle contrapposto with a hand at the obi, arched jump apex with pointed toes. Found and fixed: spring output clamp was saturated (chains flapped between limits) and chain-curl feedback made long hair flail. pxeval walk boil .022→.016 (BOILING flag gone), run .087→.057. Round 1 (kept below): walk/run/idle/jump vs the H2 frames 4→5 Opus.
verdict: Needs owner review. A/B round1→round2 (1x+4x strips): walk 4→5 Opus / 4→6 Argon, run 4→5 / 4→6, idle 4→5 / 4→6, jump 5→5 / 4→6; Argon elegance 6, no-slouch 6-8; Opus elegance 4 and still sees a forward head in idle/jump. Target 7 not reached. Open: legs overlap at passing in SE with the narrow track (P separates), sleeves flare on one half of the SE walk, bun capped at 16°.
